svg.desc: People's Square LOCATION New Administrative Capital, Egypt CLIENT Egyptian Army STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Project Overview This ongoing project covers the urban and landscape design of a major public square in Egypt's New Administrative Capital. The design combines gardens, diverse planting and open-air theatres to create active public spaces. BECT provides landscape and urban design, project management and site supervision services for the Egyptian Army.
